full_judgment: 20. In the present case, there is no scope to appeal in respect of possession and dispossession, which are very real things in life. In view of clear assertion by the plaintiff that after auction purchase he tried to go into possession but failed and that the defendants were in possession, the trial Court rightly dismissed the suit. On appeal by the defendant the appellate Court as the final Court of fact illegally reversed the findings of the trial Court regarding title and possession of about 50 years. The judgment and decree of the Court of appeal below is not a reversal of the finding arrived at by the trial Court, are not sustainable in law. Thus the impugned judgment is liable to be interfered with.
